caption: The drawing depicts a simple, long-sleeved garment, likely a tunic or shirt, rendered on a plain, light beige background. The garment is shown from the front, with both sleeves extending downwards and slightly outwards. The sleeves are gathered at the shoulders with small stitched details and at the cuffs with ruffled edges. The front of the garment features a vertical, central opening with a ruffled trim running from the collar to about a quarter of the length of the shirt. The collar is a simple band that closes at the front with a button or clasp. The lines of the drawing are delicate and precise, with subtle shading to suggest the folds and structure of the fabric. The overall composition is centered, and the colors are limited to light beige and grey pencil lines, giving the image a monochromatic appearance.
title: Man's Shirt
